name: gemini-cli
title_zh: 终端里直接跑的 Gemini 开源智能体
tagline_zh: 不用开浏览器、不用切窗口，在命令行里就能让 Gemini 读代码、改文件、跑命令。开源可自托管，数据不出你机器。
tagline_en: Skip the browser. Gemini reads, edits, and runs in your CLI. Open-source, self-hostable, data stays on your box.
desc_en: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
why_zh: 把 Gemini 的多模态推理塞进终端工作流，和你的 shell、git、文件系统原生协作。
why_en: Puts Gemini's multimodal reasoning inside your shell, git, and files—native agentic collaboration, not a web wrapper.
limit_zh: 需要 Google API key 且走 Gemini API 配额；本地无 GUI，纯终端交互。
limit_en: Requires Google API key & Gemini quota; terminal-only, no GUI; long multi-step tasks may time out—you handle retries; no fine-tuning.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Open-source Gemini agent that runs in your terminal
